shape_convention: M tokens, N output features, K input features; dW[N,K]
method: Both outputs BF16. Pure uses A[N,M], B[M,K], prequantized M32 per feature. Mixed uses BF16 dY.T[N,M], cached FP8 X.T[K,M], A online quantization. GEMM-only excludes all preparation. Sweep 18 pure and 8 mixed tiles with groups 1/13; independent top-3 retest with shuffled warm CUDA graphs, unlocked clocks. E2E diagnostics below include all current-value operand preparation for each path.

shapes.e2e_note: Mixed preparation includes Torch dY transpose copy plus the existing Triton X-transpose quantizer; pure preparation uses two Triton M32 quantizers. This compares these standalone BF16-output paths, not FP8Linear training.

contract.a_scale: int32 [ceil(M/128),roundup(N,16)], four M32 E8M0 bytes per word
contract.b_scale: int32 [ceil(M/128),roundup(K,16)], independent M32 scale for every K column
contract.alignment: M multiple of min(BM,128); K multiple of min(C,128); N tails supported
contract.quantizer: ColumnQuantizePlan pads token rows to 128 and retains BF16 online_scale semantics
contract.scope: Standalone dW plan; no autograd or FP8Linear changes
